AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Food Nutrients.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Food Nutrients.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Food Nutrients.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Food Nutrients.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Establishment Planting Site? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Establishment Planting Site.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Knitting Skills 10 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Laundry: Loose- coloured Items and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Knitting Skills 10 4.2 Constructing Framed Suspended Garden 10 4.3 Adding Value  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
